title: Spatial Risk Assessment of Foot and Mouth Disease
description: Published spatial risk assessment of Foot-and-Mouth Disease in Sukabumi Regency using GIS, Multicriteria Decision Analysis, and AHP. The map helps veterinary authorities prioritize surveillance, vaccination, and movement-control interventions.

title: Random Forest Risk Mapping of Foot-and-Mouth Disease in Sukabumi Regency, Indonesia
description: Machine-learning risk mapping of Foot-and-Mouth Disease using Random Forest and GIS predictors. The project explores spatial drivers of FMD risk and supports targeted mitigation planning in Sukabumi Regency.

title: EpiMetricsID
description: A Python/Flask epidemiology analytics workspace for descriptive analysis, sample-size calculation, 2x2 epidemiological measures, regression, diagnostic tests, and spatio-temporal mapping.

title: status-kitwan.dvmanalytics.id
description: Interactive Indonesian animal disease status map based on Kepmentan No.287/KPTS/HK.150/M/04/2026, covering PMK, LSD, ASF, Rabies, HPAI, Brucellosis, Anthrax, CSF, SE, Jembrana, and Surra.

title: PMK Simulator
description: A Shiny-based simulation tool for Foot-and-Mouth Disease spread in Sukabumi livestock populations using stochastic SEIRDVX modelling. It supports vaccination, depopulation, movement restriction, and market-day control scenarios.

title: myPuskeswan
description: A web-based Puskeswan management information system for treatment, vaccination, monitoring, surveillance, medicine stock, guest book, content records, reports, photos/videos, and dashboard analytics. Built with PHP Native, MySQL, and a mobile-friendly SPA interface.

title: Puskeswan Agentic AI
description: Agentic AI workflow for Puskeswan services: automated reports, dashboard insights, WhatsApp gateway integration, field-data processing, and decision-support routines built around real animal health service data.

title: LPJ/SPJ Automation
description: Administrative automation for SPT, SPPD, receipts, cost details, travel documentation, and vaccination schedule normalization, reducing repetitive paperwork for field veterinary activities.

title: E-LOK Activity Sync
description: Workflow automation that converts verified Puskeswan service records into structured employee activity logs, helping align field evidence, daily workloads, and performance documentation.

title: Image & Video AI generator
description: A web application for generating AI images and videos, used to support digital content creation and communication materials.

title: Lokasi Peternak Wilayah 1
description: WebGIS map showing livestock farmer locations in Puskeswan service area, supporting field planning and spatial understanding of service coverage.

title: Rawan Bencana Merapi
description: Interactive disaster-risk map around Merapi area, demonstrating WebGIS-based visualization for hazard awareness and spatial decision support.

title: Peta Risiko Penyakit Rabies
description: Rabies risk map for Sukabumi Regency, designed to support animal health surveillance, prevention planning, and public health coordination.
